state_schema.missing_data_policy: fail if holdout events, damage windows, or recovery labels are absent

dynamics.update_law: observe t0, apply frozen damage at t1, score recovery potential at t2

boundary_conditions: topology-only baselines and HAOS features must use the same frozen split and scoring path
symmetries: same execution path for target and controls

haos_mapping.haos_source: frozen HAOS recovery and closure descriptors
haos_mapping.mapping_function: score recovery potential from t0/t1 artifacts only
haos_mapping.semantic_justification: tests whether HAOS structure adds predictive value beyond topology
haos_mapping.uncertainty: must be estimated on untouched holdout

observation_map.measurement_rule: rank future recovery potential at t2

prediction_target: predict future recoverability better than topology-only methods
calibration_split: development and calibration frozen before holdout

controls.name: label_permutation
controls.purpose: destroy target alignment while preserving marginal label structure

controls.name: seed_repeat
controls.invalid_if: same seed produces materially different scores

baselines.name: shortest_path_distance
baselines.prediction_rule: rank by path distance to damage

baselines.name: graph_neural_network_baseline
baselines.prediction_rule: train on development; evaluate on untouched holdout

uncertainty: report confidence intervals, seed variance, and holdout degradation

fail_conditions: no statistically significant improvement on untouched holdout
invalidation_conditions: benchmark is tuned after holdout inspection
falsification.underpowered_policy: report UNDERPOWERED when sample-size gate is not met
falsification.leakage_policy: no target leakage into features, split, or thresholding

verdict_logic: Most likely negative; only an untouched holdout improvement over all topology baselines is a candidate success.

notes: PB-03 is a contract-first branch; no dataset or runner exists yet.
